$comment: The single source for /enterprise (pages/enterprise.html, src/enterprise.js), the /pricing company row and the printable procurement packet. Deployment surface statuses are not repeated here: they come from data/microsoft-surfaces.json, the same file /microsoft renders. Change a status only with evidence. tests/enterprise.test.js validates the shape and fails on any certification, co-sell or partner-tier claim.

marketplace.offer_comment: Set offer_url to the public SaaS offer page once Partner Center publishes it. Empty means the page and /pricing link the publisher profile and /enterprise instead.

publisher.name: three.ws
publisher.legal_entity_comment: Fill with the registered entity name and country from the Partner Center account record. Empty means the packet says the details come with the order form.

attestation.name: Microsoft 365 App Compliance: Publisher Attestation
attestation.detail: Answers are drafted from the code and have not been submitted. three.ws holds no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 report today.

buy.name: Microsoft Marketplace
buy.summary: Find three.ws on Microsoft Marketplace and buy through the Microsoft relationship your company already has. A Marketplace subscription grants the same plan a direct purchase does, activated with a Microsoft sign-in.

buy.name: Invoice or purchase order
buy.summary: Send your PO, vendor onboarding form or order form through the contact form below. We reply within one business day with a quote and invoice terms.

buy.name: Self-serve on three.ws
buy.summary: Buy the Pro plan yourself on the pricing page with an on-chain wallet payment. There is no card checkout today: companies that need one use Marketplace or an invoice.

identity.name: Sign in with Microsoft
identity.detail: OpenID Connect on the common authority with PKCE, accounts keyed by tenant and object id, strict per-tenant issuer checks.

identity.name: Entra tenant claim
identity.detail: A directory administrator claims the organisation's tenant for a team, so colleagues are offered the team or joined automatically when they sign in.

identity.name: SCIM 2.0 provisioning
identity.detail: Microsoft Entra ID adds, updates and removes people over SCIM at https://three.ws/scim/v2 with a per-team token stored only as a hash.

identity.name: SAML 2.0 single sign-on
identity.detail: Service-provider support is built and is enabled per deployment with your identity provider. It is not enabled on three.ws today.

security.label: Hosting
security.value: Google Cloud Run, us-central1 (Iowa, United States). Database on Neon managed PostgreSQL, AWS us-west-2 (Oregon). Files in Cloudflare R2. All customer data is processed in the United States.

security.label: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS only, HSTS with preload on every response, TLS to the database, storage and model providers.

security.label: Encryption at rest
security.value: Provider encryption at rest on every store, plus application-level AES-256-GCM for wallet and provider keys. Sessions, refresh tokens and API keys stored only as SHA-256 hashes; passwords with bcrypt.

security.label: Access control
security.value: Every API request checked against the caller's scopes. OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (S256 only) for apps, one-hour audience-bound access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, revocable scoped API keys.

security.label: Retention
security.value: Every retention window is enforced by a scheduled job: sessions deleted 30 days after expiry, security audit logs kept 365 days then archived, raw MCP sessions 30 days.

security.label: Backups
security.value: Neon point-in-time restore, archives to Google Cloud Storage verified before rows are pruned, immutable Cloud Run revisions for one-command rollback.

security.label: AI data use
security.value: Which model providers see prompts, and for what, is listed per provider on the subprocessor list.

security.label: Incidents
security.value: Automatic detection, documented containment steps, and notification of affected people if a breach affects personal data.

security.label: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Report to security@three.ws. The code is open source under Apache 2.0, so reviewers can read every control.

support.label: Enterprise inquiries
support.value: Reply within one business day through the contact form or support@three.ws.

support.label: Service status
support.value: Live service status and incident history are public.

support.label: Uptime commitment
support.value: No standard uptime SLA is published today. Service levels are agreed per contract on Enterprise plans.

support.label: Data processing agreement
support.value: Send your DPA or vendor questionnaire through the contact form and we review it with you.
